tgc_bot@3.8.8.summary: Version check via the site: the bot now compares its version with the version list on this site (api/versions.json, key tgc_bot) instead of GitHub releases, which always failed because the source repository is private. The console reports whether the bot is up to date and links to the changelog when a newer version is available. config/updates.js now uses Source and ScriptId; GITHUB_REPOSITORY in .env is no longer used. No database changes.

tgc_bot@3.8.7.summary: Quieter hub log: the central hub no longer logs every successful Botbericht HTTP request, but writes one hourly summary per action instead, saving over 30,000 log lines (about 6 MB) a day. Failed, aborted and slow requests are still logged immediately with their request ID. The new optional BROADCAST_HTTP_LOG setting (fouten or alles) restores full per-request logging for diagnosis. Only the central bot needs the update; no database changes.

ts_parkeerapp@1.1.0.summary: Detects fake plates through sky_mechanicjob: when the officer stands at the vehicle, the police check shows the real plate and blocks the parking fine. A new Tow vehicle button removes the fake plate and opens the jg-advancedgarages impound form. config.lua now has config schema 1.1.0 with a console notice for outdated configs; without sky_mechanicjob or jg-advancedgarages the app works as before.

ts_parkeerapp@1.0.3.summary: Fixed the camera staying open after taking a licence plate photo. After a new photo the phone now returns to Parkeren automatically through Sky Phone's OpenCustomApp export and rechecks the plate, so the photo is ready for the fine. Parking, payments, version checking, config.lua and the database are unchanged.

ts_bridge@1.2.2.summary: Scripts can check their version again once the previous check has finished, so the periodic check of ts_repairpoints and the ts_nlplates_check console command work through the central version API. Concurrent requests are still refused; caching, exports and config schema 0.1.2 are unchanged. The GitHub repository is now also named ts_bridge.

ts_repairpoints@1.1.5.summary: Version checking now runs through ts_bridge and the central TroyScripts version API instead of the private GitHub manifest, so HTTP 404 messages are gone. The startup check and IntervalHours keep working (periodic checks need ts_bridge 1.2.2); Repository and Branch are ignored and config schema stays 1.1.1.

ts_gemertmap@1.1.2.summary: Version checking now uses the central TroyScripts version API instead of version.txt on GitHub. With ts_bridge running the check goes through the bridge; without it the map queries the site itself, so ts_bridge stays optional. Config schema stays 1.0.9.

ts_nlplates@1.1.3.summary: Version checking now runs through ts_bridge and the central TroyScripts version API instead of version.json on GitHub. Config.VersionCheck and the ts_nlplates_check console command keep working (repeated console checks need ts_bridge 1.2.2). Config version stays 1.0.6.

ts_nohelmet@1.0.8.summary: Version checking now runs through ts_bridge and the central TroyScripts version API instead of the private GitHub manifest. It can still be disabled with set ts_nohelmet_version_check 0; gameplay and configuration are unchanged.

ts_parkeerapp@1.0.2.summary: New startup version check through ts_bridge and the central TroyScripts version API. The optional versionCheck setting in config.lua defaults to on when missing; parking, payments, police checks and the database are unchanged.

ts_bridge@1.2.1.summary: Central version checking now reads the public TroyScripts API instead of private GitHub repositories. Available updates link to the customer's Cfx.re Granted Assets page. Existing exports are compatible; one shared request is cached for five minutes and config schema remains 0.1.2.

ts_bridge@1.1.9.summary: Simplified provider names for dealerships, garages, vehicle keys, banking and billing. Default resource names are resolved automatically, while existing overrides and configuration schema 0.1.2 remain compatible.

ts_nlplates@1.1.0.summary: Reorganized the code into client, server, shared and config folders. Improved default webhook placeholders, manifest paths, documentation and config checks.

ts_keycard@1.3.5.summary: Stolen original cards cannot be globally revoked for 600 seconds, including after restarts. Added the /kaartinnemen command alias and relocated the inventory installation snippet.

ts_antipunch@1.8.4.summary: Limited melee cancellation to one action per episode. Added MeleeCancelMode (secondary or immediate) while retaining existing combat restrictions and camera behavior.

ts_flatbed@1.0.2.summary: Added support for energyguinchotop alongside energyrampamec. Model-specific vehicle calibrations can be saved without changing the ramps and winch workflow.

ts_gemertmap@1.1.0.summary: Radar zoom is restored after startup, respawn and /gemertmapreset. Added configurable HUD compatibility without changing map textures and postal code data.

ts_nohelmet@1.0.6.summary: The version checker now reads public fxmanifest.lua metadata instead of a GitHub release. Gameplay and configuration are unchanged.

ts_hostage@1.2.3.summary: Reorganized client, server, shared and configuration files. Updated manifest paths and Electron AntiCheat documentation, retaining gameplay and config schema 1.1.9.

ts_repairpoints@1.1.3.summary: Repair NPC target registration now retries and recovers after ox_target restarts and streaming changes. Added /reparatietargetcheck and clearer diagnostics.

tgc_bot@3.8.4.summary: Radio retries the hosting container's FFmpeg if bundled FFmpeg exits before audio arrives, with improved failure diagnostics.

tgc_bot@3.8.3.summary: Added /scriptupdate commands to configure a channel and announce script versions from UTF-8 Markdown or text changelogs, with duplicate prevention and Cfx.re asset links. Improved Twitch notification setup.

tgc_bot@3.8.2.summary: Updated dependencies and FFmpeg installation behavior. Removed the former TikTok integration and related stored data; YouTube and Twitch remain supported.

tgc_bot@3.8.1.summary: The central hub now prefers SERVER_PORT and improves HTTP keep-alive, timeout handling, retries, request deduplication and diagnostics.

tgc_bot@3.8.0.summary: Centralized Twitch-to-Discord creator mappings and automatic purple Live roles; optionally remove live announcements when a stream ends.

tgc_bot@3.7.2.summary: YouTube's API fallback is reused for one hour after a successful request, with improved RSS retry behavior and errors.

tgc_bot@3.7.1.summary: Moved documentation to docs/ and expanded /help document discovery, retaining Dutch and English guides and existing configuration.

tgc_bot@3.7.0.summary: Centralized creators and notification platform checks through the shared hub while keeping each server's Discord channels and roles independent.

tgc_bot@3.6.2.summary: Ticket archive startup scans ignore deleted channels without losing retained history. Improved missing-permission warnings and default notification setup.

tgc_bot@3.6.1.summary: The /ban command now supports a Discord ID even for users outside the server, with stronger permissions and validation.

tgc_bot@3.6.0.summary: Added /gebruikersnaam and a resumable installation workflow for server-specific bot identity and configuration, restricted to authorized users.

tgc_bot@3.5.1.summary: Ticket archives now display formatted messages, readable names, timestamps, edits, deleted messages and saved attachments.

tgc_bot@3.5.0.summary: Staff can handle their own tickets and invite participants. Ticket messages, edits, deletions and attachments are preserved in SQLite.

tgc_bot@3.4.3.summary: Ticket closure now requires confirmation, saves main and staff transcripts, then removes the channel only after successful logging.

tgc_bot@3.4.2.summary: Government ticket closure exports HTML transcripts to the configured log channel before deletion, with safe retry behavior.

tgc_bot@3.4.1.summary: Department role mentions and panel descriptions now display readable names and consistent ticket explanations.

tgc_bot@3.4.0.summary: Stopped supporting Node.js 22, requiring Node.js 24.x and updated install, workflow and bilingual documentation.

tgc_bot@3.3.1.summary: Added a coordinator-specific government ticket panel with separate roles and categories using existing claim and transcript tools.

tgc_bot@3.3.0.summary: Introduced dedicated government ticket panels with configurable department roles and responsibilities for police, ambulance, roadside assistance and fire service.

tgc_bot@3.2.4.summary: Removed an unused dependency and replaced nodemon with Node's watch mode; retained existing better-sqlite3 behavior.

tgc_bot@3.2.3.summary: Added message log filters, safer timestamp handling, YouTube API fallback and improved reconnect diagnostics.

tgc_bot@3.2.2.summary: Added a central cross-installation bot-message hub with authenticated messages and deduplicated delivery reservations.

tgc_bot@3.2.1.summary: Added owner-only /botbericht broadcasts and strengthened /say authorization and delivery logging.

tgc_bot@3.2.0.summary: Improved readable Discord audit logs and ensured that radio playback reports success only after actual FFmpeg audio arrives.

tgc_bot@3.1.9.summary: Updated Dutch and English guides, corrected npm lockfile installation and improved radio switching and notifications.

tgc_bot@3.1.8.summary: Added Radio Veronica with direct stream resolution and improved FFmpeg proxy support and error messages.

tgc_bot@3.1.7.summary: Introduced an internet radio panel with station dropdown, volume controls and automatic disconnection when appropriate.

tgc_bot@3.1.6.summary: Added configurable Discord log categories and durable queues, plus optional AI-assisted adult-content moderation with staff review.

tgc_bot@3.1.5.summary: Improved ticket closure when staff discussion threads are missing or not required, while preserving export safety.

tgc_bot@3.1.4.summary: Introduced automated CI checks and tests for version consistency, slash commands and SQLite startup.

tgc_bot@3.1.2.summary: Hardened interactive ticket actions, permissions and transcript size limits to prevent duplicate or incomplete processing.

tgc_bot@3.1.3.summary: Added configurable soft moderation for messages with staff exceptions, warnings, timed moderation and staff review.

tgc_bot@3.1.1.summary: Ticket claims use paginated member lookups and improved thread-log errors; failed exports preserve ticket channels.

tgc_bot@3.1.0.summary: Enhanced ticket claim access management, takeover controls, /ticket-add, /ticket-remove and separate staff discussion logs.

tgc_bot@3.0.9.summary: Expanded optional cross-server honeypot protection to timeouts while retaining server-specific logs and reversal actions.

tgc_bot@3.0.8.summary: Introduced optional cross-server honeypot bans for participating servers with independent local logs and unban actions.

tgc_bot@3.0.7.summary: Honeypot bans can now delete seven days of message history. Unbanning does not restore deleted messages.

tgc_bot@3.0.6.summary: Added configurable honeypot channels with bans or timeouts, persistent logging and bilingual warnings.

tgc_bot@3.0.5.summary: Introduced kitchen and home improvements that boost XP or earnings, with property valuation and persistence rules.

tgc_bot@3.0.4.summary: Improved HTTP 500 and YouTube RSS retries and made birthday role recovery more resilient.

tgc_bot@3.0.3.summary: Introduced business ownership, automated income, security upgrades, cooperative heists and bank loans.

tgc_bot@3.0.2.summary: Introduced housing purchase and rental, housing roles, XP/income bonuses and recurring rent collection.

tgc_bot@3.0.1.summary: Added economy reset controls and compulsory invoices with interest, debt handling and protected purchases.

tgc_bot@3.0.0.summary: Introduced Dutch, English and bilingual server languages, localized logs and improved mentions.

ts_antipunch@1.8.6.summary: Removed the server-specific ElectronAC line from fxmanifest.lua, so the script also starts on servers without ElectronAC. The Dutch texts in locales/nl.lua can now be edited in the Cfx version too.

ts_flatbed@1.0.4.summary: Removed the server-specific ElectronAC line from fxmanifest.lua, so the script also starts on servers without ElectronAC. escrow_ignore now points to the actual config.lua, so the config stays editable in the Cfx version.

ts_nlplates_migrate@1.0.3.summary: config.lua is now editable in the Cfx version, so you can check BlockedResources before migrating. The README now states to remove the tool after use and never add it to server.cfg. Migration logic is unchanged.

tgc_bot@3.8.5.summary: /warnings gains view, remove and clear subcommands so staff can revoke warnings, plus optional automatic timeout/kick escalation (off by default).

tgc_bot@3.8.6.summary: Adds a suggestion box with voting and staff review, persistent reminders (/herinner) and automatic temporary voice channels managed with /voice.

ts_bridge@1.2.3.summary: No more black photos in Discord: every client capture is checked for brightness, a black capture is retried once from the normal player view and is never sent as a black image. screencapture is now the default screenshot resource with automatic fallback to screenshot-basic, and the vehicle photo for ts_nlplates registration documents works again. Config schema 0.1.2 → 0.1.3.

ts_bridge@1.2.4.summary: Vehicle queries keep working when the database connection drops briefly: a failed query (for example oxmysql "This socket has been ended by the other party") is retried once after 250 ms, and a query that gets no answer within 10 seconds stops with vehicle_query_timeout instead of hanging. Exports, events and config are unchanged; config schema remains 0.1.3.

ts_bridge@1.3.0.summary: New in-game configurator: /tsconfig opens a dedicated menu (Dutch or English) to manage connected TroyScripts. The bridge detects connected scripts automatically and shows their status, version and available updates. Each script has a Config.IngameConfig switch (default true); on first start the values from config.lua are imported once. Settings are stored in the server KVP, survive updates and are migrated automatically when the config version changes. Export/import, ACE or ESX group access, server-side validation and optional Discord logging are included. Config schema 0.1.3 → 0.2.0; existing exports and events are unchanged.

ts_repairpoints@1.2.0.summary: First script connected to the ts_bridge in-game configurator (/tsconfig). A new Config.IngameConfig switch (default true) imports your current config.lua values once. Prices, payment, jobs, timings, the mechanic and compensation are configurable in-game; fixed points, the custom duty check and webhook settings stay in config.lua. A quote is refused if both damage weights are 0. Config version 1.1.1 → 1.2.0; requires ts_bridge 1.3.0 or newer.

ts_repairpoints@1.2.1.summary: English is now available as a language. Choose Dutch (default) or English with Config.Locale or in /tsconfig. All texts for players, staff, police, Discord webhooks and the server console are in locales/nl.lua and locales/en.lua and can be customised. Dutch texts are unchanged; command names and the technical F8 diagnostics stay the same. The target label switches language after a restart. Config version 1.2.0 → 1.2.1.

ts_bridge@1.3.1.summary: Place locations with mouse and keyboard: scripts can offer a Locations tab in /tsconfig where a transparent ped follows the mouse (scroll or Q/E rotates, Shift for fine rotation), so admins no longer have to walk there or switch jobs. Go there teleports next to an existing location. The script keeps storing and checking permissions itself; the bridge checks the spot is within 30 metres and logs every placement. The script list no longer overflows horizontally. Config schema stays 0.2.0.

ts_keycard@1.3.7.summary: Configure ts_keycard in-game through /tsconfig of ts_bridge. A Config.IngameConfig switch (default true) imports your config.lua values once. Language, payment method, distances, cooldowns, items, jobs, grades, prices and societies for police, ambulance and fire department, admin and revoke permissions, NPCs and forgery items are configurable. From ts_bridge 1.3.1, the Locations tab places issuance points per department and the forgery dealer with mouse and keyboard, with the same permissions, storage and logging as /kaartpunt. The department choice in /kaartpunt is now translated. Config version 1.2.1 → 1.2.2; works with ts_bridge 1.3.0; the Locations tab appears once ts_bridge 1.3.1 is installed.

ts_flatbed@1.0.5.summary: Configure ts_flatbed in-game through /tsconfig of ts_bridge (1.3.0 or newer). A Config.IngameConfig switch (default true) imports your config.lua values once. Vehicle models, admin ACE, interaction, server and stream distances, maximum cable length, winch speed, maximum slope, vehicle control timeout, remote control, wheel lift (maximum length and width, render distance), wheel dollies and the version check are configurable. Jobs, UseAce, Timing, SpeedLimits, Alignment, the remote model and animation, the ramp model and profiles stay in config.lua. The startup config check also validates in-game values. Config version 1.1.2 → 1.1.3.

ts_repairpoints@1.2.2.summary: Place and move repair points with mouse and keyboard in the Locations tab of /tsconfig (ts_bridge 1.3.1), including heading and name, and choose the mechanic's leave spot within 100 metres. When a point is moved the mechanic reappears at the new spot and an open request at that point is cancelled; a point cannot be moved during a repair. Same permissions, data/points.json storage and placed Discord log as /reparatiepunt, which keeps working. Removing still uses /reparatiepunt verwijderen [id]; fixed points from Config.Points stay in config.lua. Config version stays 1.2.1; works with ts_bridge 1.3.0, the Locations tab appears with 1.3.1.

ts_antipunch@1.9.0.summary: Configure ts_antipunch in-game through /tsconfig of ts_bridge (1.3.0 or newer); changes apply immediately without a restart. A Config.IngameConfig switch (default true) imports your config.lua values once. Language, diagnostics, aim button, first person and camera restore, all shooting and melee blocks, the cancel method and the version check are configurable. English is now available with Config.Locale = 'en'. The dead state is checked 4 times per second instead of every frame, while control blocking stays active every frame. The bridge check now actually requires ts_bridge 1.2.0. Installation docs rewritten. Config version 1.8.3 → 1.8.4; gameplay and defaults unchanged.

ts_bridge@1.3.2.summary: Search and remove locations in /tsconfig, grouped under headings. A search field appears from 13 locations; at most 100 rows are shown at once and searching finds the rest. Scripts can offer up to 2000 locations (was 100) and an optional Remove button with confirmation. Go there also works for locations without a height, such as postcodes, by finding the ground. Removing requires the same configurator permissions as saving and is logged. Config schema stays 0.2.0; ts_keycard and ts_repairpoints are unchanged.

ts_gemertmap@1.2.0.summary: Configure the map in-game through /tsconfig of ts_bridge (1.3.0 or newer, started before this script); without ts_bridge it works as before. A Config.IngameConfig switch (default true) imports your config.lua values once. Startup message, radar zoom, periodic zoom, custom area names on/off, the version check and all 46 area names are configurable; area names and radar zoom apply immediately. The Locations tab (ts_bridge 1.3.2) lists all postcodes with search, Go there, Move with the mouse, Remove and New postcode; /postcode and the exports use the changes immediately. Your postcode changes are stored in data/postcodes_eigen.json and survive updates. Names baked into the map image and Config.Points are not in the menu. Config version 1.0.9 → 1.1.0.

ts_bridge@1.3.3.summary: Weapon lists, tables and images in /tsconfig. New setting kinds: a mapping (e.g. weapon → type) and a table with fixed columns (e.g. seat pairs). Weapons are picked from a searchable list of the weapons the server knows (ox_inventory, the items database table and ESX); typing filters by spawn name and label, and custom spawn names remain possible. A new image setting lets you pick a file (resized to 256 px) or paste an https link; the server checks type and size. Scripts with several config tables can show all their settings in one menu. Config schema stays 0.2.0; existing scripts are unchanged.

ts_hostage@1.3.0.summary: Configure ts_hostage fully in-game through /tsconfig of ts_bridge 1.3.3: 105 settings from config/config.lua and config/server_config.lua, imported once on first start via the Config.IngameConfig switch. Language, controls, keys, radial menu, distances and timing, camera, hands up, vehicles with seat pairs, the weapon list (pick from the server's weapons), animations and positions per weapon type, the knife pose (also per weapon), the police alert and Discord options. English is now available. Webhook URLs and PlayerName stay in config/server_config.lua only. Config version 1.1.9 → 1.2.0.
